page.overview:
Who is Sedore Dajenna?

Sedore Dajenna was an Aes Sedai and a loyalist Sitter of the Yellow Ajah. She was also secretly part of the Black Ajah.

She was plump and had a round face with dark eyes and long dark hair. In Elaida’s opinion, she was one of the most arrogant of all among the sisters.

Sedore is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of . She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability with the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

When Sedore died, she was 187 years old. Born in Tear in , Sedore went to the White Tower in 829 NE. After spending nine years as a novice and seven years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in 845 NE.
